text: {"findings":[{"option_id":"c3.r1a1","rule_id":"functions-consumption-timeout","reason":"The nightly invoice job runs ~20 minutes but Consumption executions time out at 5 minutes by default and 10 minutes at most, so it cannot run as a single execution."},{"option_id":"c5.r1a2","rule_id":"redis-basic-no-sla","reason":"Basic tier is a single node with no replication and no SLA, meant for dev/test, while this is a production session store."},{"option_id":"c2.r1a2","rule_id":"container-apps-scale-to-zero-cold-start","reason":"Scaling on HTTP concurrency with a minimum of 2 replicas only 'during business hours' implies scale-to-zero outside it, so the first request after idle hits a cold start."}]}
